calls.title: Plusgrade<>GrowthBook - Onboarding Discussion
calls.summary: The meeting covered the operational plan for deploying two GrowthBook instances aimed at improving A/B testing for machine learning models. A sync job will facilitate regular replication of data from production to staging, ensuring compliance with platform team guidelines. The production license is being updated to address prior sharing issues, with secure access being a priority. The deployment timeline faces potential delays due to platform team workload but is targeted for completion within two weeks. Training sessions are planned post-deployment to enhance team readiness, while future data integration with platforms like Snowflake is being considered, marking a pathway for further improvements in data centralization.
calls.keywords: Production deployment, GrowthBook SDK, license management, A/B testing, AWS SageMaker, Data Science platform
